_readme: NEWBURYPORT'S SURF -- the buildings scene with a storm on the bar (2026-10-18, the rolling-wave
work): Hs 3 m, Tp 10 s from 95 deg (the storm rail's sea) at the ebb, so the entrance stands up
and the crests on the bar overturn. Two eyes seaward of the north jetty tip: `surf` from 12 m,
the bar in profile; `surf_high` from 60 m, the bar whole. The buildings, the orthos and the
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/newburyport_surf.json
